Sword & Shield series · EVS

Evolving Skies

Released August 27, 2021 · 237 cards

Expanded

Evolving Skies is a Pokémon TCG expansion in the Sword & Shield series, released in English on August 27, 2021. Its main set has 203 cards, plus 34 secret rares numbered beyond the set (237 in total). It includes 193 Pokémon, 40 Trainer and 4 Energy cards, and is legal in the Expanded format (rotated out of Standard).
